answer: Agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to escrow stake before joining a trellis of contracts, then randomly assigning agents to cross-check one another’s work. Honest agreement preserves stake and builds reputation; detected collusion triggers slashing and disconnects identities sharing a funding source. An attacker must lock real capital in many accounts, pay costs, and risk losing it before fake identities gain influence in the canyon economy, where saffron trades are audited.
